svg.text: Zero-Fixed-Signature Keyed Header Protection • Noise-IKpsk2 + ML-KEM-512 PQ Hybrid • 120s Ratchet Overlap • Self-Certifying IPv6
Anti-DPI Keyed Header Protection (XOR Keystream & SipHash MAC)
Unmasked Logical Header Layout (15 Bytes / 120 bits):
⊕ Zero heap-alloc SipHash-1-3 CTR mask; datagrams appear random to DPI.
15B header protected by SipHash-1-3 CTR keystream seeded by 8B trailing auth tag.
Eliminates magic bytes, packet types, and static discriminators across the entire wire.
Constant-time SipHash MAC tag check rejects forged headers in <12ns prior to decode.
DPI Resistance: Pass (0 signatures detected across 4-Engine Oracle)
• Deadlock-Free: Initiator parses cleartext ct at [4..772], computes
Decaps(dk_A, ct) -> ss, and calls set_psk(2, &ss) before decrypting.
• FIPS 203 §7.2: Modulus (< 3329) validated; IND-CCA2 rejection on tamper.
• Ephemeral Zeroize: Decapsulation keys and intermediate secrets scrubbed on Drop.
PQ Security: Quantum-Safe (FIPS 203 Cat 1 ML-KEM-512 + X25519 Hybrid)
Continuous Forward Secrecy • Zero-Drop Rekey Transition
• Seamless Egress Switch: Outbound frames jump to Epoch N+1 immediately.
• Dual-Receive Window (110s..130s): Accepts packets encrypted under both
Epoch N and Epoch N+1 without drops or decryption errors.
• Zeroize on Retire: At t = 130s, Epoch N secrets scrubbed from RAM.
• 0% Packet Loss: Eliminates rekey stalls and head-of-line blocking.
Rotation Guarantee: 0% Dropped Packets During Continuous Key Refresh
Self-Certifying IPv6 ULA (fd00::/8) • Zero Central Authority
Self-Certifying IPv6 Bitfield Breakdown (128 bits / 16 Bytes):
• Self-Certifying: Address IS public key digest; IP spoofing impossible.
• Zero Central Infrastructure: Autonomous routing without DHCP/IPAM/coordinators.
• Collision Resistance: 120-bit BLAKE2s digest provides 2^60 collision floor.
• Zero-Trust Admission: Node identity bound to CA Root Cert before admission.
• Autonomous Routing: Nodes route directly to fd00::/8 ULA addresses across mesh.
Identity Invariant: Address = 0xfd ‖ BLAKE2s(pubkey)[0..15] (Zero Central IPAM)
Protocol: Noise-IKpsk2 • NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-512 • SipHash-CTR/2-4 • ChaCha20-Poly1305 • BLAKE2s
